summary: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend six candidates and one education representative to City Council for appointment to the Board of Health.
decided: City Council on February 7 and 8, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Board of Health, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed: Abinaya Chandrabalan Lindsay Kretschmer Charles Ozzoude Suman Roy Ramanjeet Singh Stephanie Zhou 2. City Council appoint the following: a. Anu Sriskandarajah, Trustee, Toronto District School Board, for a term ending on December 31, 2024; and b. Ida Li Preti, Trustee, Toronto Catholic District School Board, for a term starting on January 1, 2025, and ending on November 14, 2026, and until a successor is appointed. 3. City Council direct that the education representative to the Board of Health alternate, starting in 2026, between the Toronto District School Board nominee and the Toronto Catholic District School Board nominee, with each board's representative serving a four-year term. 4. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1-3 to the report (January 24, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Board of Health.
